method: Pure original W: dimension, norm, fixed/refreshed geometry and historical RLS attribution
training_prefill: cached native expansion at final precision
protection: cyclic 61 BASIS; KL(Base || current) on actual original Base token prefixes
nullspace: fixed512 versus full10240; no rank sweep

success_criteria.untrained_generalization: no owner loses Base-correct T1G/T2G; aggregate T2G improves over Base
success_criteria.structural: same parameter keys/shapes/count; native fresh reload; no inference editor branch
success_criteria.evidence: development pilot; not independent clinical/SOTA confirmation
success_criteria.insertion_correct: all24 native/GFIT at own insertion and every later prefix
success_criteria.attribution: registered within-round contrasts; full denominators, owner-wise regressions, missing-aware bounds; no winner selection or compensation

adaptation_notes_zh: 五臂纯原W诊断；不增加推理参数或分支。
学习率、数据、顺序、步数、保护KL和成功阈值保持；B仅改变预先指定的幅度规则。
完整零空间用薄QR隐式投影，固定与每编辑刷新分别检验。
旧失败评分不重试；新候选一次评分，缺失阻止成功声明。
仅一次已暴露DEV顺序，不能声称独立临床/SOTA或作者完整复现。

interventions.B_NORM: A directions; same-state full-null update norm
interventions.D_FULL_REFRESH: full current-W right nullspace refreshed each edit, P=I
interventions.E_RLS: fixed512, round2 ALWAYS_ON historical RLS, gamma=1

norm_matching: B: -min(.05,.01*||G Pi_initial_full||)*d512/||d512||; zero d512 skips; includes same weighted CE+KL gradient
history_update: E only; after each edit, original seven source rho and one private BASIS key; no normalization change
diagnostics: separate CE/KL norms, full/low energy, current-gradient RLS attenuation, update dot CE/KL; no shadow writes
GPU_schedule: GPU5 only; one GPU worker at a time; all5 train/freeze before all5 final evaluations
engineering_attempts: Preserve all attempted calls and failures; resume only uncommitted work; scientific updates/output consumers fixed, counters cannot reset
resume: exact per-step dense W or low-coordinate state, D boundary QR, E historical inverse; atomic commit and independent step journal
scoring: same isolated Astra medium; valid exact old scores reused; prior failed same-binding payloads remain missing; no retries
checkpoint_lifecycle: active state retires after bound candidate and train receipt; candidates after prefix/final/native reload/durable Judge inputs; geometry/cache after all consumers
